text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we finished shopping and were
about to head home with Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait a second...?
Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... It's the Wagyu hamburger steak
I used to eat back home!
choice_data_list: Huh, it sure does look delicious.
Huh, it sure does look delicious.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's super delicious.
Not just my family, but a lot of the locals are big fans too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Still, it's a wee bit pricey, so we only get to eat it for celebrations. It's a special mem—huh?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is this price...? No way,
it's way too cheap...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me, about this hamburg steak...
Is the price tag wrong?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
No, that's right. Honestly, the expiration date is coming up soon.
It's really good stuff and I don't want it to go to waste, so I'm offering a discount.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Heh, oh my... Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you wouldn't happen to be from out west, would you?
Actually, I was born over that way myself.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
If you buy all the stock we have here,
I'll take another half off. How's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Another half off...?! T-That's definitely
tempting, but why give such a deal to us...?"

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
When you live in a foreign land,
your memories of home inevitably start to fade, you know?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text: If eating this helps you remember your hometown, then this hamburger steak couldn't ask for a better fate!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Manager...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Aww, what a wonderful person.
Yeah, living here really is
super comfortable.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that land is what raised me to who I am today.
I won't forget my gratitude to it, not even for a second.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(To prove it, I'll show 'em all!
The overflowing love I've got for my hometown!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
I have a special favor to ask ya...
choice_data_list: Let's invite everyone over for a hamburger steak party!
Let's invite everyone over for a hamburger steak party, shall we?
Let's devour it all! The taste of our memories!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
I have a special favor to ask ya...
choice_data_list: Let's invite everyone over for a hamburger steak party!
Let's invite everyone over for a hamburger steak party, shall we?
Let's devour it all! The taste of our memories!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's a nice idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That way, I won't overeat,
no meat goes to waste, and everyone gets
to taste how delicious this is!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Would ya call somethin' like this a win-win-win?
Well, whatever works."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Manager, I'll gladly partake in
every last bit of your local pride!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the hamburger steak party with everyone
wrapped up to great acclaim, leaving both bellies
and hearts fully satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure?
Like, warning me not to overeat and all...
choice_data_list: I'll put together a weight-loss plan for you when that happens.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, thank you very much.
Well then, I won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, being able to eat that hamburg steak until I'm stuffed
feels like a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Lucky Lilac thoroughly
savored the taste of her memories.
